title: Planning a tennis trip? Start with these three checks.

voiceover.text: Planning a trip around tennis? Before you book, answer three questions.

First: what tennis experience are you travelling for? Write down what you want to attend, then check ticket information directly with the official organiser. Don’t build your plans around assumed access.
Second: how long do you want to stay? Separate your tennis plans from the time you want to spend exploring. Put accommodation and local transport on your checklist.

Third: what still needs confirming? Keep a short list: tickets, accommodation and how you’ll get around. Mark each item as checked or pending. You don’t need a perfect itinerary today. You need a clear starting point.
Save this checklist for your next tennis trip, and explore Tennix Travel when you’re ready to plan further.

caption: Tennis trip on your mind? Start with the experience, the length of your stay and what still needs confirming. Save this checklist before you book. 🎾
newsletter: Your next tennis trip starts with a checklist. Before booking, check official ticket information, decide how long you want to stay and separate accommodation from local transport. Keep unconfirmed details clearly marked.
